description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_2d_x_dirichlet.esm (model Heat2DxDirichlet, test mms_heat_x_dirichlet_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NX=64, NY edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered mirror-ghost Dirichlet second-derivative rule central_D2x_dirichlet_bc on the full 2-D field with homogeneous walls gL=gR=0. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
